segments.source: `callbackType`: The option to specify when the system must call the completion handler.
segments.ko: `callbackType`: 시스템이 completion handler를 호출해야 하는 시점을 지정하는 옵션입니다.

segments.source: `completionHandler`: The handler the system calls after the player schedules the buffer for playback on the render thread, or the player stops.
